name: Squisito
headline: Home » Squisito
lede: SQUISITO ME, based in Dubai offers wide range of soft interior furnishing products.
about: Squisito's in-house team of stylists are continuously striving to draw inspiration from global trends yet imbibing them with the regional flavors respecting the culture of the native. Thus, bringing up a wide spectrum of decor ranging from the traditional to the modern.
Squisito offers an extensive and impressive range of fabrics, wall coverings, wall decor, rugs, curtains, upholstery, and other interior decor items that showcase utter luxury and class.
